reason_rejected: Merging stale IME composition with overlapping app/model edits has no strong source precedent in inspected editors and is harder to prove than cancellation.
ProseMirror gives strong pressure, but Slate v2 still needs explicit policy/taste before changing runtime semantics.
Lifecycle protection strengthens active-composition proof gates, but it does not replace ProseMirror as the explicit overlap-cancellation authority for Slate policy.
